sloka: प्रासैः प्रमथिताः केचिद्वानराः शोणितस्रवाः ।मुद्गरैराहताः केचित् पतिता धरणीतले ।। ६.५२.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: prāsaiḥ pramathitāḥ kecidvānarāḥ śoṇitasravāḥ ।mudgarairāhatāḥ kecit patitā dharaṇītale ।। 6.52.19 ।।।।

translations.english: Few Vanaras mutilated by barbed darts, some struck with mallets, blood oozing dropped down.
